annotations.title: Add India Central Government Working Days

description:
Use this when you need a deterministic central-government date offset with a required office scope. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when you need an exact state/UT, bank, employer, school, exchange or locally selected optional-holiday calendar.
What it computes: Adds or subtracts dates using the pinned 2026 central-government Gazetted schedule and weekend baseline; Restricted and local optional selections are not inferred.
Example user requests: Add five Delhi central-government working days after 2026-10-16.
Inputs: start_date (date); office_scope (enum); working_days (integer).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"start_date":"2026-10-16","office_scope":"delhi_new_delhi","working_days":1}
Outputs: start_date, result_date, working_days_added, calendar_days_elapsed, gazetted_holidays_skipped, restricted_holidays_available_at_result, territory, territory_name, office_scope, office_scope_name, is_guaranteed_non_working_day, day_type, restricted_holiday_available, calendar_scope, rest_day_policy, restricted_holiday_policy, selection_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: move one day at a time; decrement remaining only when selected status.is_working_day=true
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/india-central-add-working-days with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/india-central-add-working-days.md

office_scope.description: Required scope: delhi_new_delhi or outside_delhi. State/UT holiday calendars are not represented by this package.

working_days.description: Signed offset; start date is excluded for non-zero offsets.

name: add_india_central_working_days

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

day_type.description: Weekly rest day, gazetted holiday, restricted option or regular weekday.

is_guaranteed_non_working_day.description: True for the weekly baseline or an applicable gazetted holiday.

restricted_holiday_available.description: Whether a restricted-holiday option is listed on the date.

restricted_holiday_policy.description: Restricted and locally selected optional-holiday rule.

restricted_holidays_available_at_result.description: Restricted options on the result date.

selection_policy.description: Whether local optional selection is required.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.
